name: Employee Attendance Summary
query:
SELECT 
    project.project_customer AS "Project Name:Data:200",
    eam.object AS "Object:Data:150",
    user.full_name AS "Team Leader Name:Data:200",
    eam.employee AS "Employee ID:Link/Employee:150",
    eam.full_name AS "Employee Name:Data:200",
    COUNT(eam.date) AS "Total Days:Int:100",
    SUM(eam.duration) AS "Total Hours:Float:100",
    eam.allowance AS "Allowance:Data:200"
FROM 
    `tabEmployee Attendance Master` eam
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabProject Setup` project ON eam.project = project.name
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabUser` user ON project.team_leader = user.name
WHERE 
    eam.date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    eam.project, eam.object, user.full_name, eam.employee, eam.full_name
ORDER BY 
    eam.project, eam.object, user.full_name, eam.employee;
